## **Spread the Word!**

Invite people from your local WordPress community to join WordCamp Europe. We’ve prepared some ready-made materials for you to choose from. Of course, we encourage you to use your own voice – you know your community best and how they would like to be invited to join the global WordPress community.

Excited for WordCamp Europe 2026? Let’s Make It Unforgettable Together!

So… What can you do to spread the word about WordCamp Europe?

It is not always easy to spread the word about events you are about to attend, so… To help you out a bit, we prepared some ready-to-use copy & paste content for you to use.\

*[Get your ticket and join the experience](https://europe.wordcamp.org/2026/tickets/)!*

</div>
